lead: Identical token prefix vs full generate. Both paths used the same input tokens; no extra chat turn was inserted. A text mismatch would warrant investigation; numerical differences can also change generated output. Matching text does not mean the answers were correct, and does not validate the 40-step latent rollout, compression, or the full agent-to-agent handoff. Differing outputs in the earlier plan4_diag ordinary-versus-cached comparison used differently formatted prompts, so they were not evidence of cache corruption.
this_run: All three prompts matched (dummy, L1 compact, L3 compact). None truncated. On fam-000-base both paths reported P q=40; gold is 10. Splitting the prompt did not introduce that mistake.
